in_marathi.name: Illisha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Ila's grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Illisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit name Ila, meaning 'goddess'. This name embodies the grace and blessings of the divine feminine. In Hindu mythology, Ila is the wife of Vishnu's avatar, Vamana. She is known for her beauty and kindness.
